summary: Create your own animals farm and raise happy animals in this farm animals game!
description:
TIZI FARM LIFE AWAITS YOU!

Hello little farmers! Create your own farm life story in the Tizi Town Village - Farm Games. Visit the village and help the farmers. Plant the seeds and harvest the crops. Go and ride the tractor through the farm! Boys and girls, get ready to experience the village life in the Tizi Town Farm Games like never before!

FARMING GAMES
Carry out farming activities in the big farmland of Tizi Town Village. Grow your own crops. Harvest fresh fruits and vegetables. Drive a tractor in the field. Exciting farm games for farmer boys and girls! Create your own stories in the Tizi Town Village Farm.

FARMHOUSE
Stay in the fantastic farmhouse. A classic vintage farmhouse filled with lots of activities. Relax in the beautiful verandah. Taste authentic food in the farmhouse kitchen. Play dress-up games for girls and boys. Choose your favorite costumes, accessories, dance styles, and expressions for your characters. Enjoy the farmhouse games with family and friends!

ORGANIC FARMERS' MARKET
Check out fresh vegetables and fruits for sale at the farm-fresh market. Pluck your favorite fruits and vegetables, wash them and package them. Buy organic groceries from the farm shop. Kids, enjoy the farm life and have unlimited fun in the Tizi Town Village - Farm Games!

BARNYARD
Little farmers, discover the animals and learn about them! Take care of the animals in the barnyard. Feed the cow, sheep, and chickens. Do poultry farming and collect the eggs. Supply milk from the dairy. Package and process your goods at the factory!

Explore the farm life in the Tizi Town Village - Farm Games. Meet friends and join them on farming adventures. Be the best farmer you could be!

Little farmer boys and girls, play and have endless fun with characters. Create your own farm life stories. Download now!
